thread:
sophie_pm: Heads-up: we need a concrete rollout plan for the subscriber-scoped performance toggle. Customers asked for per-subscriber canaries + explicit fallback to stable model on quality regressions.
devin_eng: ok. I assume we still want regional weighting (US/EU/APAC) and HW caps?
sophie_pm: yes: start EU, then US, then APAC. HW cap: prefer p3a for EU canary.
harry_data: For gating, recommend p50 and p95 latency + user-reported quality tickets. Concrete: p95 < 320ms and no >0.4% increase in user-reported regressions over 1h.
nina_sre: add circuit-breaker: if any region p95 > 700ms for 15m, cut traffic to 30% globally. Also watch KV-cache churn metric.
devin_eng: we should treat single-tenant spikes separately. Proposal: per-subscriber cap of 200 reqs/min and burst window.
sam_se: Dedicated tenants will need an opt-out toggle surfaced in their Console with audit log. Make sure API supports tenant_id scoping.
jess_support: Support asks: one-click rollback per-tenant + automatic incident when rollback happens. Also pre-baked support message for customers.
ci-bot: ci-bot: rollout job queued: name=subscriber-canary, region=eu-west1, hw=p3a, owner=devin_eng
harry_data: A/B quality check: send 4k prompts across 8 intent families; target statistical significance p<0.05; measure answer-consistency and hallucination proxy. I'll publish baseline CSV by EOD.
sophie_pm: Ramp plan idea: sample-based ramp by subscribers not by traffic: 10 subs -> 50 -> 200 -> 1000 -> all. Each step 36h monitoring window for external, 12h for internal. Manual approve at 200 and 1000.
nina_sre: 36h seems fine. Also require an ops-run for the 1000-step to ensure GPU pressure is okay.
devin_eng: Acceptance criteria draft: - No region p95 violations during stable window. - Hallucination proxy delta <= 0.3% absolute. - No more than two support regressions per 1k subscribers.
sam_se: Note: mapping for quantized models needed. If a Dedicated tenant uses int8 variant, fallback should map to closest compatible id.
jess_support: Workflow: support triage creates scoped rollback ticket + toggles flag for tenant_id. Notify SRE and PM. Include templated message to customer with expected time to restore.
harry_data: Telemetry: include model_variant, quant_tag, token_count, and sample traces at 5% for deep-analysis. Aggregates for rest. 30-day retention for aggregates, 7 days for full traces.
nina_sre: small tweak: increase trace sample to 8% for first 72h of each ramp step.
sophie_pm: Decisions so far: EU-first, phased subscriber counts, manual approval at midpoints, one-click rollback per-tenant, telemetry sampling ramp for early windows.
devin_eng: Actions: - Devin: implement subscriber selector and flag API changes - Harry: publish baseline evals + sampling config - Sam: Console toggle + audit log design - Jess: support rollback playbook - Nina: circuit-breaker tests and run ops dry-run
sophie_pm: I'll update the roadmap ticket and ping legal for any Dedicated customer notices. Reconvene Thursday 10am to sign off after Harry's baseline.
jess_support: I'll draft the customer-facing rollback FAQ and link here.
devin_eng: started code branch for subscriber-selector. will open PR soon.
harry_data: uploaded baseline -> /evals/subscriber_canary/baseline_v1.csv and note.
ci-bot: ci-bot: canary job started (eu-west1/p3a)
sophie_pm: thanks team, will follow up with PR links and the updated acceptance checklist. :white_check_mark:
notes: subscriber-scoped canary ramp; includes ci-bot messages and file refs
